title: JSFL fl stubs: language, scriptURI, configURI, alert, openScript
description:
Add trivial missing JSFL surface to makeFlProxy in packages/authoring-ui/src/jsfl/runtime.ts:
1. fl.language: getter returning 'en'
2. fl.scriptURI: getter returning ''
3. fl.configURI: getter returning ''
4. fl.alert(message: string): calls window.alert(message) in browser context (or console.warn fallback)
5. fl.openScript(fileURL: string): console.warn stub returning void (currently only runScript exists — add openScript as a separate stub with same behavior)
Add all 5 to JsflFl interface and makeFlProxy.
